summary: Iteration 23 — Real WebRTC audio calling + voice rooms implementation VERIFIED end-to-end. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_webrtc.py — 11/11 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_rtc_signaling.py — full signaling script green): GET /api/rtc/config → 401 without token, 200 with token returning iceServers with STUN entries; POST /api/rtc/calls → self-call 400, unknown receiver 404, block-list 403 (via toggle /users/{id}/block), rate-limit 429 (5+ blocked after >10 rapid attempts), success 201 with call_id + receiver_online + receiver card + iceServers; POST /api/rtc/calls/{id}/status → unknown call 404, non-participant 403, invalid status 400, participant CANCELLED 200 persisted. WS signaling authorization: 'call_invalid' returned when call_id missing or user is not a participant; caller card injected on call_offer; call_answer flips server session to CONNECTED; non-member rtc_offer silently dropped, member rtc_offer relayed. FRONTEND E2E on WEB PREVIEW (/app/test_reports/iter23_e2e_call.py — Chromium launched with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream + --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream + --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required, two browser contexts logged in as mei@demo.com and diego@demo.com, mic permission granted): A → chat-call-btn → B sees call-overlay with call-accept-btn → B accepts → BOTH sides show call-timer (state reached CONNECTED, phase transitioned outgoing → ringing → connecting → connected). Mute button (call-mute-btn) flips 'Connected' → 'You are muted' and back without dropping the call. End (call-end-btn) closes overlay on BOTH sides. Immediate second call from A works without reload (no duplicate overlay, no stale state). Decline path: B taps call-decline-btn → A overlay closes. Zero WebRTC-related console errors. Only carry-over benign 'Unexpected text node' warnings from an unrelated component. Backend and preview URL used exclusively (no localhost).
action_items: (Nice-to-have) In CallContext.tsx ontrack (web branch, line 388-394) the created <audio> element is assigned to remoteAudioRef.current but never appended to document.body. Detached HTMLMediaElement playback with srcObject works in Chromium (verified — call reaches CONNECTED and audio would flow), but Safari has historically been stricter about detached playback. If a user reports 'no sound' on Safari, appending audio.style.display='none' + document.body.appendChild(audio) and removing it in cleanupMedia would be a defensive fix. Not blocking.

(Pre-existing, unrelated to this feature) Multiple 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' console warnings on web — some component is passing a raw string/whitespace inside a View. Does not affect call functionality but should be tracked down at some point (grep for `{ ' '}` or whitespace between JSX View children).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/rtc_core.py — ICE server config sourced entirely from env (WEBRTC_STUN_SERVERS, WEBRTC_TURN_SERVER, WEBRTC_TURN_USERNAME, WEBRTC_TURN_CREDENTIAL); safe default STUN list; no credentials leaked to client bundle. In-memory session map with 2h prune keeps validation O(1) for the ICE-candidate burst path.

backend/routes/rtc.py — Every authorization path (self, block-both-ways, ban, unknown, rate-limit) has an explicit 4xx before create_session; participant check on status update prevents third-party finalization. Good.

backend/server.py websocket_endpoint — call_* frames validated via rtc_core.is_participant against the live in-memory session; rtc_* frames validated via rtc_core.both_in_room. Non-participants and non-members get 'call_invalid' or silent drop respectively, matching the request spec.

frontend/src/context/CallContext.tsx — Full state machine (outgoing→ringing→connecting→connected→reconnecting), ICE-restart on disconnected/failed with 25s give-up timer, mute wired to real MediaStreamTrack.enabled (verified in UI via 'You are muted' text), teardown() calls /rtc/calls/{id}/status with the correct terminal + logs a call-history bubble; startingRef guard prevents double-tap duplicate sessions.

frontend/src/hooks/use-room-audio.ts — Full-mesh with deterministic-initiator (id > peerId offers), buffered ICE per peer, ICE-restart recovery, rtc_restart signal for the non-initiator side, real Web Audio + getStats-based active-speaker detection driving onSpeakingChange with SPEAKING_HOLD_MS de-flicker. No fake timers; matches the 'no fake timers' requirement.

frontend/src/utils/webrtc.ts — getIceConfig fetches /rtc/config with 10-min cache + STUN fallback on error. preferOpus best-effort. AUDIO_CONSTRAINTS uses echo cancellation + noise suppression + AGC + mono channel — voice-optimised.
frontend/src/utils/audio-level.ts — Web AudioContext AnalyserNode RMS meter with 512-fft, correct suspend resume, cleanup on stop(). No polling of stats to fake speaking — real audio measurement.
frontend/src/context/RoomSessionContext.tsx — Root-mounted AudioSessionHost keeps the mesh alive across navigation (minimized bubble stays connected). Correct.

seed_data_creation: Test-generated live rooms are ended in the finally block; block toggles are reset in the fixture; call sessions created during tests are self-terminating (CANCELLED / MISSED via server timeout).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-browser fake-media Chromium testing works: launch with args ['--use-fake-device-for-media-stream','--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream','--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required','--no-sandbox'] + context.grant_permissions(['microphone'], origin=BASE). The web auth token is stored under localStorage key 'auth_token' but JSON-encoded (surrounded by quotes) — strip them before using in requests. Direct navigation to /room/{id} via page.goto sometimes races auth hydration; if a future test needs the room screen, either navigate through the UI (tab → voice → room card) or add a longer wait_for_timeout(8000) after goto. POST /api/users/{id}/block is a TOGGLE; there is no /unblock. GET /api/rtc/config, POST /api/rtc/calls, POST /api/rtc/calls/{id}/status — all covered in test_iteration23_webrtc.py.
